ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food web, if all the sea weeds were washed off due to tsunami, which organism will be most affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, there is a “seaweed” label at the bottom middle position; there is a “limpet” label at the lower right. It can be seen that there is an arrow from seaweed pointing to limpet, indicating that limpet directly depends on seaweed as a food source. Reasoning: The question asks which organism is most affected if all the seaweed is washed away by a tsunami. According to the rule in a food web that arrows point from food to the eater, organisms that directly eat seaweed will be affected first and most obviously. Therefore, the most affected are limpets.
